arcs.title: The Duck Bandit Returns
arcs.summary: Day 2: A second duck has appeared, wearing a different but equally well-made hat — a wide-brim amber felt, jaunty angle. One witness (T. Finch) reports a 'purposeful shape' near the Jeep but has gone quiet. The Ministry's Duck Provenance Office, staffed by junior analyst Pemwick, has opened a formal inquiry and noted that both hats share the same stitch count, suggesting a single maker. The Jeep is clean of all charm traces. Day 3 should develop a new clue — perhaps Pemwick finds something significant in the stitch pattern, or a third duck appears with a different hat that completes some kind of set or sequence, or someone in the broader Jeep community recognises the hat style as specific to a known (if elusive) figure.
